text: This major aims to cultivate high-quality applied specialized talents in stomatology who master the basic knowledge, theories and skills of basic medicine and clinical medicine, as well as the professional knowledge and skills of stomatology, and are competent for the diagnosis and treatment of common oral diseases. The main courses include Introduction to Stomatology, Oral Biology, Oral Anatomy and Physiology, Oral Histopathology, Oral and Maxillofacial Medical Imaging Diagnosis, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Endodontics, Periodontology, Oral Mucosal Diseases, Pediatric Stomatology, Prosthodontics, Orthodontics, Preventive Stomatology, Oral Materials Science, Geriatric Stomatology, and Oral Equipment Science, etc.This major lasts for six years, including one year of professional internship, and confers a Bachelor of Medicine degree.
